title: Ancient stalagmites reveal exceptions to Asia–South America monsoon seesaw over the past 450,000 years
description: In places like South Asia, Africa and parts of the Americas, monsoon rains supply water for drinking, crops and hydropower for billions of people. Understanding the patterns that monsoons tend to follow can help people plan for drought risks affecting agriculture, reservoirs and hydropower across distant regions.

title: Ancient Fire, Modern Magic: Halloween Torch-Making Workshop
description: Discover a traditional and hands-on way to transform dried mullein stalks into beautiful, functional torches. In this workshop, participants will work with harvested mullein stalks and carefully dip them into melted wax, building up layers to create their own handmade torches. Learn about the plant, the traditional craft of torch-making, and the simple process of waxing the stalks, in perfect time to light it for Halloween to ward off any ghosts.
